name: World Air Quality Index (WAQI)
tagline: Global real-time AQI from 11,000+ stations with a free token tier
description: JSON API from the World Air Quality Index project (aqicn.org / waqi.info) for real-time air quality at city and station level worldwide. Covers 11,000+ stations and 1,000+ cities with pollutant breakdowns (PM2.5, PM10, NO2, CO, SO2, O3), geo/IP lookup, map bounds queries, station search, and multi-day AQI forecast. Auth is a free self-serve token; default published quota is 1,000 requests/second. Terms restrict selling data and use in paid apps without agreement.

auth.details: Free API token via query param `token=` on every request (e.g. ?token=YOUR_API_KEY). Self-serve signup by email at aqicn.org/data-platform/token/; demo token `demo` works for sample calls.

pricing.free_tier_limits: All APIs free with a valid token; default published quota is 1,000 requests/second
pricing.paid_plans: No self-serve paid plans; contact WAQI for larger quota or commercial/for-profit use agreement

rate_limits: Default quota: 1,000 requests/second; contact for higher limits
use_cases: get current AQI and dominant pollutant for a city by name
get air quality nearest to latitude/longitude coordinates
search air quality monitoring stations by name or region
list stations and AQI inside a map lat/lng bounding box
read PM2.5/PM10/O3/NO2 breakdown for a station
get multi-day air quality forecast for a city feed
